description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractPolicyEventStrategy within the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.policies.persistence.actors.strategies.events. It provides a template for handling PolicyEvent instances, specifically managing null policies and applying events to build or modify Policy objects. The class includes methods for handling events, applying events to PolicyBuilders, and constructing Policies with updated revision and timestamp information.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a template for event strategies that process PolicyEvent objects, handle null policies, and apply events to PolicyBuilders for further handling.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for creating instances of AbstractPolicyEventStrategy.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a PolicyEvent and an existing Policy by updating the Policy with the provided revision and timestamp, and applies additional event logic via applyEvent method.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overloaded method; one version applies an event to a PolicyBuilder, the other to both an event, a Policy, and a PolicyBuilder. Subclasses may override these to implement custom event application logic.
